file_url.description: Generator 上传成功后返回的文件 URL

functionDeclarations.name: generate_3d_model
functionDeclarations.description:
Generate a NEW 3D asset from text, one image, or 2-4 consistent views (front/left/back/right; all providers). For multiview, prefer named view URLs and omit missing directions; inspect images to verify left vs right (never assume a generic side image is the left view) and never send an unsplit reference sheet. For reuse, use search_model_lib, or search_my_assets for explicit personal-history requests only.
Rodin Lowpoly (rodin_lowpoly) is the default for text, single-image, and multiview generation when the user leaves the model open or simply asks for Rodin. Omit provider or use provider=rodin for ordinary requests. Use provider=rodin_lowpoly for explicit Lowpoly, or rodin_lowpoly_remesh for existing models.
Honor explicit provider, model_version, and tier choices. For high-poly/high-detail requests (高模、高精度模型、高面数模型) with no model specified or with Rodin/Gen-2.5 without a tier, set provider=rodin and tier=Gen-2.5-Extreme-High. Plain Gen-2.5: provider=rodin + requested tier (or Gen-2.5-Extreme-Low). Pass any requested face count as face_limit.
For Tripo without a version, set provider=tripo and omit model_version (default P2-20260801; ineligible accounts receive a subscription notice and no task). Tripo P1 is not available through MCP; MCP Tripo requests never switch to Rodin. Use v3.1-20260211 for Tripo H3.1 high detail (up to 1.5M polygons). Use hunyuan for explicit Hunyuan requests.
Optional reference prep (separately billed; review views before 3D): generate_image for orthographic white-bg cleanup, or generate_3d_reference_views for 4 named views.
Follow server cost-confirmation responses (requesting a model approves selection, not spend). Local references: file_upload first.

back_image_url.description: Multiview back CDN URL (omit if unavailable).

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

delight.description: Tripo Texture 3.5 only: remove baked lighting (default true).

face_limit.description: Rodin Lowpoly: target triangles (200–20,000, default 4,000, aim 2,000–5,000, incl. quad mode). With provider=rodin or omitted and no tier, integer >20,000..2,000,000 selects Gen-2.5-Extreme-High (Gen-2.5 maps to quality_override). Tripo P2 quad caps at 25,000.

front_image_url.description: Multiview front CDN URL (required with named view URLs; pair with >=1 other direction; exclusive with image_url/image_urls).

generate_parts.description: Tripo H3.1/H3.0 only: generate untextured editable triangle parts in one GLB (adds a parts fee; forces texture/pbr/quad/smart_low_poly=false; set with_fbx=false to keep grouping; exclusive with with_segmentation).

geometry_instruct_mode.description: Rodin Gen-2.5 geometry mode: faithful (default, closer match) or creative.

hd_texture.description: Rodin Gen-2.5 texture enhancement (may reduce input similarity).

hy3d_model.description: provider=hy3d only: default hy-3d-3.1; hy-3d-express is fast, text/image only (no multiview).

image_urls.description: Legacy multiview alternative to named URLs: comma-separated or JSON array in fixed front,left,back,right slots. Keep missing slots empty (e.g. front,,back); never compact. Prefer named URLs for partial views. Local images: file_upload first.

left_image_url.description: Multiview left CDN URL (Tripo character nose/chest/toes face image-left; inspect image, not filename/sheet position; omit if unavailable).

material.description: Rodin Lowpoly only: default PBR (None or texture=false for geometry only).

mesh_mode.description: Rodin Lowpoly only: overrides quad (use FBX for native faces).

mode.description: Generation mode (text prompt, single image, or 2-4 directional views).

model_version.description: tripo only. Omit for default P2-20260801 (quad, low face count; subscription required); v3.1-20260211 is H3.1 ultra-high detail (explicit/upgrade).

negative_prompt.description: tripo text_to_model only (<=255 chars; shorten on error, do not retry unchanged).

pbr.description: Generate PBR materials (default true for tripo/rodin, false for hunyuan).

prompt.description: Text prompt (required for text_to_model; Rodin Lowpoly/Tripo max 1024 chars).

provider.description: Default rodin_lowpoly. provider=rodin selects Rodin family (Lowpoly by default, or Gen-2.5 when paired with tier). provider=hy3d pairs with hy3d_model.

quad.description: Quad-dominant mesh (Rodin Lowpoly) or quad output (Tripo P2); default true. False for triangles; use FBX for native Lowpoly quads.

rigging_ready.description: Rodin Gen-2.5 only (provider=rodin + tier): use official Hyper3D lane so task ID works as unirig_rig.asset_id with confirmed textures.

right_image_url.description: Multiview right CDN URL (Tripo character nose/chest/toes face image-right; inspect image, not filename/sheet position; omit if unavailable).

texture.description: Generate textures (default true for Rodin Lowpoly/Tripo).

texture_delight.description: Rodin Gen-2.5: remove baked lighting from textures.

texture_mode.description: Rodin Gen-2.5 texture quality (default high for Extreme-High, medium otherwise).

texture_quality.description: tripo texture quality: default standard; fast (3.5 only, same price/size, less detail); extreme is 8K.

texture_version.description: tripo texture model, independent of model_version (default v3.5-20260815; pin older only when requested).

tier.description: Rodin Gen-2.5 tier (pair with provider=rodin; omit for Rodin Lowpoly).

with_fbx.description: FBX output (default true for Rodin Lowpoly/Rodin/Tripo; false for generate_parts/Hunyuan). False for GLB.

with_segmentation.description: tripo only (default false): run extra post-generation segmentation task (adds fee; exclusive with generate_parts).

functionDeclarations.name: generate_3d_reference_views
functionDeclarations.description: Prepare four 3D reference views from ONE uploaded image using 全能耀斑 (Flare). Returns a normal image task. Output contains the source sheet plus referenceViews.front/left/back/right PNG URLs. This step costs one medium-quality 2K image, separately from 3D generation; there is no extra slicing fee. Show the views for review: unseen sides are inferred and may need correction. Then pass referenceViews.front/left/back/right to the matching front_image_url/left_image_url/back_image_url/right_image_url fields of generate_3d_model(mode=multiview_to_model) with Tripo, Rodin or Hunyuan; omit any missing direction. Do not send the unsplit sheet to 3D generation. Never automatically charge for 3D before the user has reviewed the views. For simple reference cleanup, use generate_image with a prompt for a straight-on orthographic view, white background, even diffuse lighting and unchanged identity/proportions, or separate components. Those are optional, separately billed image edits.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

image_url.description: One uploaded CDN image URL (local: file_upload first).

prompt.description: Optional details to preserve or clarify; the four-view layout is added automatically.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_effect_video
functionDeclarations.description: Generate an effect video by chaining image generation and video generation (Seedance2). Input a prompt describing the desired VFX — the backend automatically generates an image, then uses it as the first frame to produce a green-screen effect video.

image_size.description: Image size preset: square_hd, square, portrait_4_3, portrait_16_9, landscape_4_3, landscape_16_9, auto

is_segmentation.description: Whether to remove image background (default false — keeps green screen for Unity ChromaKey)

prompt.description: Description of the desired VFX/effect video

seed.description: Random seed for video generation, -1 for random (default -1)

functionDeclarations.name: generate_eight_dir_sprite
functionDeclarations.description: Create eight-direction sprites in three reviewed stages using this ONE tool. Call step=sheet, then after reviewing the result call step=video with parent_task_id, then after reviewing the video call step=slice with its task ID. Do not auto-chain without user confirmation. Sheet uses ordinary Frontier pricing; video uses Seedance 2.5 (default) or MiniMax H3 Max pricing; slice is always free. Each cost confirmation authorizes only its own stage; there is no extra workflow charge. Ask for a reference image or character_hint and the action before sheet generation. Before step=video, ask the user to choose video model doubao-seedance-2-5-260628 (default) or MiniMax-H3-Max. One sheet per call; redo creates another separately billed task. Output: direction-named PNG sequences and preview GIF. Not the 4x4 generate_sprite_animation workflow.

action.description: Sheet stage motion preset; default walk.

character_hint.description: Sheet stage: character description, required without a reference image (including custom action).

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

custom_description.description: Sheet stage: required for custom action.

duration.description: Video seconds. Seedance 2.5: 4–15 (default 4). MiniMax-H3-Max: 5–15 (default 5). Charged using ordinary video pricing.

fps.description: Slice rate 1–12; default 12. Input max 64 MiB, 15s, 1920px edge; total sampled pixels at most 64 million.

image_urls.description: Sheet stage: comma-separated CDN reference images (local: file_upload first).

max_frames.description: Slice sampled-frame cap 1–180; default 180. Lower fps/cap for larger videos.

model.description: Video model for step=video only. Ask the user to choose before calling. doubao-seedance-2-5-260628 (Seedance 2.5, default) or MiniMax-H3-Max.

parent_task_id.description: Required for video/slice: completed preceding stage task ID owned by this user. Action, background and source asset are recovered server-side.

prefix.description: Slice filenames: 1–64 letters, digits, underscore/hyphen; default sprite.

quality.description: Sheet quality; default medium, priced by the selected image model.

resolution.description: Video resolution. Seedance 2.5: 480p/720p/1080p (default 720p; 1080p is 10-bit H.265 and unavailable to internal @unity.cn accounts). MiniMax-H3-Max: 480P/768P (default 768P; 720p maps to 768P).

step.description: Current stage only: sheet, video or slice.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_game_ui_kit
functionDeclarations.description: Generate a game UI asset kit in two async steps. Use ONLY when the user explicitly requests independently layered UI assets (UI screenshots or transparent images alone use generate_image; never infer layering permission). Step 1 (omit screenshot_url): generates a UI screenshot. Step 2 (pass screenshot_url + the effective provider RETURNED by step 1, including qwen after subscription fallback): extracts assets. Providers: seedream (default, 5.5 for both steps -> 1 base + up to 16 transparent layers + metadata; step 2 quotes up to 17 outputs, settles input + actual output pixel tiers); seedream_pro (explicit Pro; personal-lite/non-paid accounts auto-fallback to qwen before cost confirmation, confirm_cost cannot override); qwen (5.5 screenshot + Qwen 4 layers, no high-cost gate); frontier_flare (Flare screenshot + magenta cutout sheet for manual slicing). Each step is cost-evaluated independently; step 1 consent never approves step 2.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

prompt.description: Step 1: UI screen description (e.g. 'fantasy RPG inventory screen...'). Step 2: still required; reuse original prompt.

provider.description: Workflow provider (default seedream). Step 2 must pass the effective provider returned by step 1.

screenshot_url.description: Step 2 only: step 1 screenshot CDN URL. Omit for step 1.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_image
functionDeclarations.description:
Generate or edit images. Ordinary providers return one image; MiniMax H3 Image accepts 1–10 outputs. Seedream layering returns multiple outputs. Omit provider for server routing and let the server choose the model. Set provider only when the user names it. Respect server subscription/fallback decisions. Tell the user which model the server returns.
Local selection is opt-in for an explicit request to change a specific area while preserving the rest; a reference image or vague "improve it" does not imply it. Ask if the area is unclear.
Only enable layering when the user explicitly requests image decomposition or independent layers. Ordinary generation, reference-image editing, transparent backgrounds and UI screenshots do not imply layering. For requested layering, use generate_image_layers (Seedream 5.5 by default). Explicit seedream_pro or qwen retains its model and rules. See parameters for input, size and billing limits.

auto_route.description: With provider omitted, ordinary generation and editing use automatic routing by default. If no compatible model can be quoted, no task is created. Set auto_route=false and omit confirm_cost to decline an upgrade and use Seedream 5.5. Local editing defaults to Flare and supports Flare and Sunburst. An explicit provider takes priority.

complexity.description: Flare/Sunburst 2.6 planning effort (default high), independent of render quality.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

disable_prompt_enhanced.description: MiniMax H3 Image text-to-image only: disable prompt enhancement; requires exact image_size or a fixed aspect ratio.

edit_mode.description: Local edit (auto-enabled by mask_url or edit_region; omit all three for ordinary edit): 1 source image sets price/size, frontier_flare default or frontier_sunburst. Ignores resolution/image_size/output_format; outputs source-sized PNG (no segmentation/resize). Server-composited ordinary edit: protected pixels stay intact, edited content not guaranteed.

edit_region.description: Local edit box for an explicit user-requested area: normalized [0,1] x/y/width/height from top-left, inside image (verify source first; ask if unclear; no drawing UI). Exclusive with mask_url.

footnote.description: hy_image_v35 only: optional watermark text, at most 16 characters.

frame_count.description: GIF only: 2–16 frames (default 9). image_size must be auto/256x256/512x512; resolution unused.

frame_duration_ms.description: GIF only: 20–2000 ms/frame, rounded to 10 ms (default 200).

image_size.description: Preset: square_hd, square, portrait_4_3, portrait_16_9, landscape_4_3, landscape_16_9, auto; or JSON-encoded pixels: {"width":1024,"height":768}. MiniMax H3 Image also accepts WxH or X:Y; default auto/4K. In automatic routing and hy_image_v35, explicit pixels take priority over the resolution tier.

image_urls.description: Comma-separated CDN file_url references (local: file_upload first).

images.description: Deprecated base64 array; do not use (use image_urls).

is_segmentation.description: Transparent background (default false). Seedream 5.5: native RGBA PNG; explicit Seedream Lite: background removal.

layer_decomposition.description: Seedream layering (default false; explicit layering requests only; prefer generate_image_layers). 1 PNG/JPEG >=512x512 -> base + transparent layers. 5.5 default (billed input + actual outputs, quoted by max_images); explicit seedream_pro keeps Pro. Resolution: size.

markup_url.description: Flare/Sunburst 2.6: separate transparent PNG annotation layer matching first image_urls size (<=50 MB / 16 MP; do not flatten; exclusive with mask_url/edit_mode/edit_region). Guidance only; outside pixels may change.

mask_url.description: Local edit Alpha PNG matching source size (<=4 MiB; transparent=edit, opaque=protect, partial=blend; opaque B/W invalid). Exclusive with edit_region. Use user/agreed mask, never guessed. Upload changed masks under a new content-hash filename: file_upload deduplicates by path.

max_images.description: Seedream 5.5 layering only: max outputs incl. base, 2–100 (default 17; Pro fixed 17).

num_images.description: MiniMax H3 Image only: output count 1–10, default 1; charged per successful image.

output_format.description: MiniMax H3 Image: jpeg (default)/png/webp. Frontier: png/jpeg/webp, plus GIF animation and editable SVG (Baidu 2.6 text-to-image only, no refs/segmentation/resize).

prompt.description: Image prompt. Seedream layering: empty string for automatic split, or a split hint; the field is still required.

provider.description: Omit for server routing. Use seedream for Seedream 5.5 (default, 1K/1.5K/2K, up to 10 references, priced by input count and output resolution), seedream_lite only when the user explicitly requests Seedream 5.0 Lite, seedream_pro for Seedream 5.0 Pro, frontier_flare for 全能耀斑/Flare, frontier_sunburst for 全能日辉/Sunburst, hy_image_v35 for 混元图像3.5 Preview, minimax_image for MiniMax H3 Image (fast 4K generation, up to 16 references, priced per image), or qwen for 千问生图3.0 Pro (Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro).

resize_width.description: Optional post-generation resize width in px (unsupported by minimax_image).

resolution.description: minimax_image: 1K/2K/4K (default 4K); exact image_size overrides the tier. hy_image_v35: 1K default, 2K or 4K; image_size sets ratio or exact custom WxH via JSON. All tiers cost the same credits. Frontier family: 1K default; 2K/4K scale image_size ratio. Seedream 5.5: 1K default, 1.5K or 2K; exact pixels override the tier. Seedream Pro and qwen support 1K/2K only. Ignored for other providers and layering; use size for layering.

seed.description: hy_image_v35 only: optional integer seed from 0 to 9007199254740991 (MCP JSON precision limit); zero means random.

size.description: Seedream layering only (default auto, follows input).

source_task_id.description: Optional owned completed task ID for local edit history linkage.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_image_layers
functionDeclarations.description: 仅在用户明确要求图片分层或拆出独立图层时调用；普通生图、参考图编辑、透明背景、UI截图均不代表分层需求，不得自动追加。默认 Seedream 5.5：输入一张图，输出底图+独立透明 PNG 图层及位置/名称元数据；输入图计一次，输出按实际像素档结算（预估按上限，auto 按高档估）。显式 seedream_pro 保留 5.0 Pro 及原订阅/定价；显式 qwen 保留 1–8 层。点名模型不代表同意费用。 Local images: file_upload first.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

image_url.description: Input image CDN URL. Seedream requires 1 PNG/JPEG, 512x512 (>=262144 px) to 6000x6000.

max_images.description: Seedream 5.5 output cap incl. base: 2–100 (default 17). Pro fixed at 17; quote is upper bound.

prompt.description: Required for qwen. Optional split hint for Seedream (omit to auto-split).

provider.description: seedream (default 5.5), explicit seedream_pro (5.0 Pro), or qwen.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_material
functionDeclarations.description: Generate a seamless PBR surface material texture. For full-frame opaque texture images; background removal is disabled. Combine material_preset, texture_pattern, and material_style to auto-build the prompt.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

model.description: Default Seedream 5.5. Select Lite only when explicitly requested.

prompt.description: Custom text prompt, combined with selector prompts when provided (optional)

functionDeclarations.name: generate_model_lods
functionDeclarations.description: Generate 2–4 Level of Detail meshes (LOD / 多级细节) from an existing static model. LOD0 retains source geometry. Blender is the default for ordinary LOD requests. When the user asks for Rodin Fast, prefer method=rodin-fast: one Fast request produces LOD1 and Blender simplifies the farther levels from it. Select rodin-fast-all when each lower level should use Fast. Fast rebuilds topology and UVs and transfers source textures. Each Fast target must be between 200 and 20,000 triangles. Supports self-contained GLB, binary FBX, or a ZIP containing one model and its textures. Bones, animation and morph targets are rejected. Returns GLBs, measured triangle counts, screen-height transitions and a complete archive. The package costs one conversion plus one Rodin Lowpoly price per Fast level, billed on success. Local files: file_upload first.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

image_url.description: Optional mesh refinement reference image URL for the Rodin Fast modes.

method.description: Reduction method. Defaults to blender. rodin-fast uses Fast for LOD1 and Blender for farther levels. rodin-fast-all uses Fast for each lower level.

model_url.description: Asset CDN file_url of the input GLB, FBX or ZIP; never a local path or upload_url.

ratios.description: 2–4 decreasing geometry retention ratios including LOD0=1; every ratio is 0.05..1. Defaults to [1,0.5,0.25]. Targets are approximate; report measured triangle counts.

screen_heights.description: Optional viewport-height lower bounds, one per level, strictly decreasing below 1 and ending at 0. Defaults to [0.6,0.3,0] for three levels. The final zero keeps the last LOD visible.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_motion
functionDeclarations.description: Generate character animation with Hunyuan text-to-motion, delivering FBX only. Provide a motion description such as 'walk forward / wave right hand'; optionally refine it with rewritten_text and set seeds via random_seed_list. Hunyuan retains direct submission and its original result.urls response.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_music
functionDeclarations.description: Generate background music or full songs (ready-made music/ambience: search_audio_lib). sonilo (default): instrumental from text/video, per-second billing (include "bgm" or "background music" in prompt). minimax: MiniMax Music 3.0 full songs (auto/custom lyrics or instrumental), 1 MP3 track, per-track billing. mureka: Mureka Music v9 songs/instrumental, 1-3 tracks, per-track billing. Report only the completed result's audio URLs in output.data.audioUrl and output.data.tracks.

aigc_watermark.description: minimax only: tail watermark (default false). Mureka always appends a 5s watermark.

bitrate.description: minimax only: bps (e.g. 256000; omit for default).

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

duration_seconds.description: sonilo only: 1-180s (omitting quotes 90s). Text: set explicitly for length (game BGM 15-30s, loops 30-60s). Video: quote uses this value, output follows video length, final billing uses measured duration when available.

gender.description: mureka lyrics_to_music only: vocal gender tendency.

lyrics.description: minimax/mureka lyrics_to_music only: full lyrics with \n breaks and [Verse]/[Chorus] tags (MiniMax <=3500, Mureka <=5000 chars).

mode.description: minimax/mureka only (default instrumental): instrumental (no vocals), text_to_music (model writes lyrics), or lyrics_to_music (uses lyrics).

n.description: mureka only: tracks per request, 1-3 (default 1; cost = per-track × n).

prompt.description: Music description. sonilo: required without video_url. minimax/mureka: required for instrumental/text_to_music; optional style hint for lyrics_to_music.

provider.description: Default sonilo. minimax/mureka per-track prices are admin-configurable.

sample_rate.description: minimax only: Hz (e.g. 44100; omit for default).

styles.description: mureka text_to_music only: comma-separated from pop, rock, jazz, r&b, edm, ambient, folk, latin, k-pop, j-pop, house, gospel, lo-fi.

video_url.description: provider=sonilo only: reference video CDN URL (mp4/mov/webm/m4v/gif) for synchronized audio. Local: file_upload first.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_prompt_from_media
functionDeclarations.description: 基于豆包多模态识别：输入一张/多张图片、视频或音频 CDN URL（图片≤10、视频≤5、音频≤5，总计≤12），解析其内容并自动生成一段忠实复刻该素材的高质量生成提示词（prompt），可直接用于 generate_image / generate_video / generate_sound_effect / generate_music 等生成工具，或作为素材的文字描述。不需要指定目标生成类型——输出即还原素材本身。单次任务，默认 8 积分。 Local media: file_upload first.

image_urls.description: Comma-separated CDN image URLs (1-10 张)。至少需要 image_urls / video_urls / audio_urls 之一。

style_hint.description: 可选：追加的风格/侧重/用途说明（如只想突出角色、或需要额外描述更细节点）会被并入复刻指令。

functionDeclarations.name: generate_skybox
functionDeclarations.description: Generate a 360-degree skybox from text or reference images. Use proactively for Unity 3D scenes needing a visible sky/environment (match art style, time of day, weather; reuse suitable skies or skip when hidden); follow the completion guide to import and verify in Unity. Defaults to 全能耀斑天空盒 (Flare; use provider=rodin only on explicit request, never auto-fallback). Flare returns a fixed bundle (seam-corrected 2048x1024 and 8192x4096 PNGs, LDR-derived 2048x1024 float32 EXR, 2044x1022 relative-depth PNG). Report the actual returned model. Local images: file_upload first.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

high_res.description: Rodin only: high-resolution skybox (Flare always returns the fixed full bundle).

image_urls.description: Optional comma-separated reference image CDN URLs.

nadir_correction.description: Flare only: off (default, preserves ground detail); soft feathers final 6% to one south-pole color (may blur paving; local smoothing, not AI inpainting).

prompt.description: 360-degree scene, art style, palette, time of day and weather (required if no image_urls).

provider.description: auto (default, Flare), flare, or rodin (explicit request only; no auto-fallback).

scene_mode.description: Flare only: full (default, keeps street-level panorama & ground underfoot); distant (far backdrop for scenes with separate playable ground).

functionDeclarations.name: generate_sound_effect
functionDeclarations.description: Generate sound effects from text or reference video (billed per second; ready-made themed SFX/music/ambience: search_audio_lib). Proactively use in Unity gameplay for missing attack, jump, pickup, UI or ambient audio (reuse suitable clips; respect requests for silence). Describe source, action, timing and character; include "sound effect" or "SFX" in prompt. Use only the returned audioUrl; follow the completion guide to integrate and verify in Unity.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

duration_seconds.description: Seconds, 1-180; default 8 for text input. With video, omit: output follows video length and billing uses actual generated duration.

prompt.description: Sound description, max 500 characters, Chinese/English. Required without video_url; otherwise optional (auto-captioned from the video when omitted).

video_url.description: Reference video CDN URL (mp4/mov/webm/m4v/gif) for synchronized audio. Local: file_upload first.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_sprite_animation
functionDeclarations.description: Generate a transparent PNG 4×4 grid sprite sheet (16 frames) via frontier_flare (全能耀斑) with native background removal. Fixed output contract: ONE continuous chronological animation per call (left-to-right, top-to-bottom across rows); rows/columns are NOT directions, actions or variants, and prompt wording cannot reconfigure this layout. Split independent actions or directional variants into separate calls (4 directions = 4 calls). Static images use generate_image; 8-direction sheets use generate_eight_dir_sprite. Optional image_urls guide character identity/style only. Local images: file_upload first.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

image_urls.description: Optional comma-separated CDN reference URLs (guide character identity/style only, not grid layout).

output_format.description: Fixed to png for transparency; legacy overrides normalize to png.

prompt.description: Subject, style, viewpoint and ONE continuous motion (e.g. front-facing walk cycle, coin spin); no row/cell/frame layout directives. Max 31477 Unicode chars.

quality.description: Fixed to medium; legacy overrides normalize to medium.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_sprite_atlas
functionDeclarations.description: Pack multiple sprite images into a single atlas texture. Downloads all input images, arranges them using shelf-packing, and composites into one PNG/JPEG atlas. Returns the atlas image URL and a JSON layout describing each sprite's position (x, y) and size (w, h). Supported input formats: PNG, JPEG, GIF (WebP is NOT supported). This is a synchronous operation — the result is returned immediately (no task_id polling needed). Local images: file_upload first.

image_urls.description: Comma-separated CDN URLs of individual sprite images to pack.

output_format.description: Output image format (default: png). JPEG does not support transparency.

power_of_two.description: Force atlas dimensions to power-of-two (default: true)

functionDeclarations.name: generate_tts
functionDeclarations.description: Read the user's exact text as speech. Pass voice_id (from search_tts_voices or voice_clone) OR voice_query (server resolves); omit both for default narrator. Never rewrite spoken text or put delivery instructions in prompt; send tone/mood through emotion and identity/timbre through voice_query. Provider is inferred from the voice. Never substitute named characters; unavailable/ambiguous voices return candidates without creating a task. Reuse the returned voice_id for the same character. No implicit cloning.

audio_format.description: Default mp3; must be supported by the selected voice.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

emotion.description: Delivery tone/mood (not in voice_query; exclusive with emotion_prompt). Check voice's `emotions` in search_tts_voices first (unsupported rejects): MiniMax accepts all 9; Volc 2.0/Qwen apply as instruction; Volc 1.0 multi-emotion accepts a subset; fal clones accept 7 (no calm/fluent).

emotion_prompt.description: Free-form delivery beyond the 9 emotions (<=60 chars, e.g. 慵懒地、带一点嘲讽). Mutually exclusive with emotion. Qwen and Volc 2.0 official voices only (check `emotionPrompt` in search_tts_voices). Delivery only; do not request speed, volume or language changes here.

emotion_scale.description: Emotion intensity 1–5 (default 4). Volc 1.0 multi-emotion only; requires emotion.

language_boost.description: Optional pronunciation language (e.g. Chinese, English). Does not translate prompt.

prompt.description: Exact spoken text, 1–9999 chars. volc_voicelib max 1024 UTF-8 bytes (~341 Chinese chars); split longer text.

quality.description: high (default); fast selects MiniMax Turbo (MiniMax voices only).

sample_rate.description: Optional mono sample rate. MiniMax default 32000; Volc/Qwen/volc_voicelib default 24000 (Qwen also 12000/48000).

voice_id.description: Canonical ID from search_tts_voices or voice_clone customVoiceId (legacy MiniMax IDs accepted). Exclusive with voice_query.

voice_query.description: Natural-language voice identity/timbre/accent (e.g. 低沉温柔的中文男声, 熊二 2.0); do not guess IDs. Put delivery tone in emotion, not here. Exclusive with voice_id.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_video
functionDeclarations.description: Generate video from text, image frames or reference media. For Seedance talking-head lip-sync (数字人、口播、对口型), use provider=seedance2, mode=multimodal and generate_audio=true. Put the presenter or Active portrait reference in image_urls and the exact narration in audio_urls. Reference @Image 1 and @Audio 1 in the prompt and verify the lip-sync in the output. Use seedance_portrait_library for reusable presenters and file_upload for local media.

audio_urls.description: Comma-separated audio URLs for narration and lip-sync, voice, rhythm, mood or pacing. Seedance also accepts Active audio portrait references. For Seedance use multimodal with WAV/MP3, at least 2s per clip and up to 15s total on 2.0 or 30s on 2.5. Seedance 2.0 needs an image or video alongside audio.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

duration.description: Output seconds, default 5. Match the narration length for talking heads. Seedance 2.0 generates single 4–15s clips; 16–60s auto-splits video and reuses the audio reference. For long synced speech, split narration at sentence breaks and submit each 4–15s clip separately. Seedance 2.5 series: 4–30s per clip. With Seedance reference video, -1 chooses duration automatically and estimates at the model maximum. MiniMax-H3: 4–60s (>15s splits); MiniMax-H3-Max: 5–15s.

generate_audio.description: Seedance only, default true. Keep true for talking-head audio. MiniMax always generates audio.

image_urls.description: Comma-separated image CDN URLs or, for Seedance, Active references from seedance_portrait_library. Keep the returned reference intact. Check both pixel dimensions: Seedance requires at least 300 px per side; MiniMax-H3 reference images require 256–5760 px per side.

mode.description: text_to_video: no media. first_frame: 1 image; first_last_frame: 2 ordered images (first, last); both frame modes reject video/audio. Seedance reference_image: images only. Seedance multimodal: requires video or audio. Use multimodal for a presenter with audio narration. Reference limits (images/videos/audios): Seedance 2.0=9/3/3; 2.5=30/10/10; 2.5 Flash=10/5/5. Seedance 2.0 audio needs an image/video; the 2.5 series allows audio-only. MiniMax-H3: reference_image and multimodal are the same reference mode, max 9/3/3 and 12 files total, requiring an image or video; prefer multimodal for video/audio. MiniMax-H3-Max supports only text_to_video/first_frame/first_last_frame.

model.description: Seedance default: doubao-seedance-2-0-mini-260615. For default or Qianfan portraits select doubao-seedance-2-0-260128 (2.0 standard), or doubao-seedance-2-5-260628 if the user explicitly requests 2.5. When the user explicitly requests Seedance 2.5 Flash or 2.5 Lite, use doubao-seedance-2-5-flash-261115. MiniMax default: MiniMax-H3. MiniMax-H3-Max requires explicit user request.

prompt.description: Chinese or English. Required for Seedance text_to_video and every MiniMax mode. Seedance references use @Image N, @Video N and @Audio N. Example: "@Image 1 faces the camera and speaks in sync with @Audio 1."

provider.description: seedance2 (default): ByteDance Seedance 2.0/2.5 with Chinese and English prompts, narration references and virtual portraits. minimax_h3: MiniMax/Hailuo H3 or H3 Max. Choose MiniMax when explicitly named or for 2K or H3 durations over 30s (up to 60s). Select a variant via model.

ratio.description: Seedance: adaptive by default; the 2.5 series forces adaptive for first_frame/first_last_frame and multimodal with video. MiniMax: text_to_video defaults to 16:9 (adaptive forbidden); image/reference modes default to adaptive, following input images.

resolution.description: Seedance 2.5: 480p/720p/1080p (1080p is 10-bit H.265). Seedance 2.0 standard: 480p/720p/1080p/4k (4k is 10-bit H.265). Seedance 2.5 Flash and 2.0 fast/mini: 480p/720p only. Seedance defaults to 720p; 1080p/4k are unavailable to internal @unity.cn accounts. MiniMax-H3: 768P/2K (default 768P; 480p/720p map to 768P). MiniMax-H3-Max: 480P/768P only (default 768P; 480p maps to 480P, 720p to 768P); no 2K.

return_last_frame.description: Return the last frame as a preview (Seedance only, default false).

video_urls.description: Comma-separated video CDN URLs or, for Seedance, Active video portrait references. Seedance accepts MP4/MOV clips of at least 2s each, with up to 15s total for 2.0 or 30s for the 2.5 series. For 2.5 series video edits the source must be at least 4s. Seedance credits include all reference durations and the output, with a minimum token charge. MiniMax-H3 accepts 2–15s per clip and at most 15s total.

functionDeclarations.name: hy3d_process
functionDeclarations.description:
Run a Tencent TokenHub HY-3D post-processing job. One tool covers the HY-3D toolchain; pick action:
- component: split an FBX model into named GLB parts
- format: convert FBX, GLB, or an OBJ ZIP to STL/USDZ/FBX/MP4/GIF/OBJ/GLB
- texture: generate textures for an untextured OBJ/GLB (optional reference image)
- uv: unwrap UVs (<=30k faces, <=100 shells)
- retopology: retopologize a high-poly model (face_level high/medium/low)
- rigging: rig a humanoid/animal model and optionally apply one of 48 preset motions
- motion: text-to-motion FBX (1-12s). Retargeting requires an HY-3D animation-template result.
- polygen_image: generate a low-poly model directly from an image
- polygen_mesh: decimate an existing high-poly model
Input: pass model_url (public http(s) model, <=60MB) or original_model_task_id (a completed task in this account). Provider job ids from Tripo/Rodin are NOT accepted. Local files: file_upload first.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

enable_pbr.description: Enable PBR material generation (texture/rigging where supported).

model_url.description: Public http(s) source URL. For format use FBX, GLB, or a ZIP containing OBJ, MTL and textures. For motion, omit for standalone animation or supply an HY-3D animation-template result.

motion_type.description: Preset motion id 1-48 for action=rigging (omit for rig only).

original_model_task_id.description: A completed task whose output matches the action's required source. Alternative to model_url.

prompt.description: Motion description (motion action; required, <=128 characters) or texture style hint.

functionDeclarations.name: publish_inspiration_game
functionDeclarations.description:
Codely's official game sharing (free, outside catalog; default unlisted, Public only on explicit choice). “能分享嘛” or “同意” to an invitation authorizes publishing the verified build directly with no hosting menu or extra confirmation.
1. Package limits: 100 MiB packaged, 256 MiB expanded, <=512 entries. Windows: ZIP exported player dir with .exe at root. Android: signed APK. H5/WebGL: ZIP self-contained build with index.html at root, relative asset URLs (e.g. Vite base './'), playable in opaque-origin sandbox without origin storage/credentials. H5 signals ready on load by default (delayed init sets window.codelyWaitForGameReady=true before load and calls window.codelyGameReady?.(); WebGL calls it after init). Pass native_launch_key only if configured.
2. Fast path: reuse the tested package and existing playtest screenshot (collect missing size/entries in one local command; never rebuild, re-playtest, or generate art). Call action=prepare with stable request_id, title, build_type, exact size_bytes, confirmed=true (and accepted recommendation_id). Retry prepare with the same inputs and request_id to renew expired upload URLs. Run the returned literal curl upload command (no shell variables or Authorization; HTTP 204 = success; skip already-uploaded builds/absent screenshots). Finish with the same request_id and screenshot selection. Reuse the approved selection and token together if previewed, or omit both for a title-only poster. Follow the returned single web_fetch check and receipt Markdown.
3. Cover update/retry: action=poster with game_id or play_url, confirmed=true, stable operation_id, selection, and previous_version from latest receipt (empty if missing). Withdraw: action=withdraw with game_id or play_url.

confirmed.description: True in prepare or poster after the user agrees.

operation_id.description: Stable ID for a cover update or retry.

previous_version.description: Latest poster_version for an update, or empty if no poster.

request_id.description: Stable ID for prepare and finish.

tagline.description: One short line about this game's actual gameplay, shown prominently beside the QR. No generic scan instruction.

selection_token.description: Exact token returned with the approved preview.

functionDeclarations.name: recommend_inspiration_game_share

Omit action for a quick invitation (no image work needed); end the turn and wait for a user reply (never authorizes publishing by itself). Direct “能分享嘛” or accepted invites go straight to publish_inspiration_game. Use prepare_image/preview only when the user requests cover preview/edit (PUT screenshot, then preview with draft_image_id and a short game-specific tagline; source=text is no-image fallback). Generate a background only on request: use background_quote, get approval of the reference and credits, call generate_image with returned arguments, and preview the result before applying it.

confirmed.description: True for background_reference after the user approves the image and credit quote.

recommendation_id.description: Stable ID for this game's invitation and previews.

functionDeclarations.name: recommend_model_lib

This is NOT a keyword search: when the user names what they want, use search_model_lib instead. Returns up to limit (default 3, max 10) models with previews and prices; pass a returned model_id to download_model_lib. Returns an empty list when the user has no download history yet -- in that case fall back to search_model_lib with 2-3 core nouns. Free; does not consume the search quota.

asset_id.description: Your completed Rodin task ID or asset UUID. For prior uploaded-model or rigging results, use the model file URL.

functionDeclarations.name: search_audio_lib
functionDeclarations.description:
Search Codely's audio asset library: themed, game-ready sound groups (SFX sets, music tracks, ambience). Each result is ONE sound group zip containing all sibling clips of the same theme with Unity .meta files under a deterministic import path. Returns audio_id, event_type, duration, loop flag, clip_count, and a 1h preview_url to audition before downloading.

Map the request to `event` (primary filter) and put specifics (material/mood/context) in `query`, e.g. '拾取金币音效，清脆愉悦' -> event=pickup, query='金币 清脆 愉悦'. See filter params for category/duration/loop/format. Free search (up to `limit` matches with `offset`; zero-hit falls back to AI semantic ranking, rank_source=jev_fallback). Search purposefully (1-2 queries/task); do NOT enumerate via offset/keyword sweeps (per-minute rate limit & daily quota). Acquire via download_audio_lib(audio_id) (first download charges credits; repeats free). Search-only requests stop at results.

event.description: Primary filter: attack(攻击/命中/挥砍/射击) | ui(按钮/点击/悬停) | ambient(环境/天气/氛围) | victory(胜利/升级/结算) | magic(魔法/技能/施法) | voice(人声/语音) | pickup(拾取/金币/收集) | damage(受伤/死亡) | explosion(爆炸) | monster(怪物吼叫) | door(门/机关) | jump(跳跃/落地) | footstep(脚步/移动) | music(BGM/场景音乐) | horror(恐怖/惊吓) | animal(动物叫声) | vehicle(载具/交通)

max_duration.description: Max duration in seconds (>0), e.g. 1 for short UI stabs. Excludes unknown durations.

min_duration.description: Min duration in seconds (>0), e.g. 30 for looping ambience/BGM.

query.description: Free-text qualifiers (material/mood/context, e.g. '金币 清脆 愉悦', 'metal crisp'). Optional when event/category is specific enough.

functionDeclarations.name: search_effect_lib
functionDeclarations.description: Search 1300+ ready-made toon particle effects (returns up to `limit` matches, best first; `offset` pages). Free; does not download anything. Explicit generation/production requests use generation tools directly. When building/improving Unity gameplay, proactively search for hits, explosions, spells, pickups or weather effects matching scene style/palette; reuse suitable project effects, respect minimal-effect requests, and never force an unrelated match. When acquiring an effect, call `download_effect(effect_id)` for the selected match only (first download charges credits; repeats free). It returns the zip and Unity integration guide. Semantic fallback results (zero keyword matches) are AI-ranked.

limit.description: Max effects to return per call, 1-20 (default 5).

offset.description: Zero-based match index to page from. 0 (default) = start at the best match.

query.description: Search keywords, e.g. 'fire explosion', 'blue magic', 'sword slash', 'rain', 'heal', 'muzzleflash blue'

functionDeclarations.name: search_inspirations
functionDeclarations.description: Proactively discover game ideas, beginner starter projects, original creation prompts, tutorials and templates in the Inspiration Center; never personal history. Search early for open-ended onboarding or capability questions ("你能干什么", "what can you do?") and vague game-creation requests without a chosen game ("给我做个游戏", "make me a game"), as well as when a user is new, unsure what game/project to make, asks how to start or describes a starter mechanic. The user does not need to explicitly say they are a beginner. For these onboarding requests, finish the reply after presenting the starter choices so the client can show its cards; do not use ask_user to duplicate project selection, auto-select a default game, or begin implementation. Let the user choose a card or reply with a choice. For these broad prompts, use a beginner starter-game discovery query rather than searching the literal capability question. An explicit request for references is not required. For beginner discovery use starter_only=true and top_k=3 to present up to three relevant curated text-prompt starter games (ordinary showcase games are excluded), with their start-creating actions before asking a long setup questionnaire. Keep each reply to at most three inspiration choices; do not repeat searches or read extra items just to expand the same reply. Offer more choices only when the user asks. Respect explicit requirements and existing project context; do not interrupt unrelated debugging with recommendations. Read selected matches with get_inspiration before detailed claims; reuse results for the same topic. Partial/error does not mean no match. Synchronous and free; search/preview never starts creation or charges.

query.description: Current game idea/problem or beginner uncertainty (for example: first game, what should I build), stage and explicit constraints.

starter_only.description: Use true for beginner/first-game discovery: return only curated starter projects, excluding ordinary showcase games. Default false.

top_k.description: Maximum references returned, default 3. Return at most three choices per reply, including beginner discovery. Does not limit the catalog scan.

functionDeclarations.name: search_learn_courses
functionDeclarations.description: Find learning resources for Unity. Use this tool when the user wants to learn Unity or find Unity tutorials, courses, lessons, guides, examples, or practice projects, even if they do not mention a specific learning platform. Search Unity 中文课堂 for courses, tutorials, learning projects, and quizzes. Query is optional for browsing; when provided, use one language with 1–3 core concepts and do not append translations, synonyms, or generic terms. Filter by skill level or tutorial price when useful. Use get_learn_course_detail to inspect a selected result. Present learning resource links using url exactly as returned, preserving all query parameters.

query.description: An optional concise, single-language query containing 1-3 core concepts. Omit it to browse learning resources.

price_mode.description: Optional tutorial price filter. When set, the search returns tutorials only.

functionDeclarations.name: search_model_lib
functionDeclarations.description:
Search Codely's platform-maintained 3D model catalog: ready-made prefabs/meshes with dependency ZIPs. This is the only 3D catalog (all ready-made models, including open-license prefabs/animations, live here), so every model request goes through this tool. Separate from search_my_assets (explicitly requested personal generation history). For new-model requests, follow the routing policy in the served instructions: for readily-available subjects, search this library first and present ready-made download vs generation to the user; generate with generate_3d_model only when no suitable match exists or the user explicitly wants generation.

Free search; returns metadata, model_id and preview_urls (show previews to help pick). Semantic fallback results are AI-ranked; verify suitability. Search purposefully with 2-3 core nouns (1-2 queries/task): do NOT pass full sentences or long prompts (word-by-word index drops matches to zero), and do NOT enumerate via offset/keyword sweeps (per-minute rate limit & daily result quota). Acquire via download_model_lib(model_id) (first download charges credits, repeats free). Search-only requests stop at results; do not bulk-download or turn empty searches into generation.

after.description: Opaque cursor for sort=recent browsing. Pass the `next_cursor` from the previous response to fetch the next page without offset.

category.description: Top-level category: Animations | Characters | Environments | GUI | Props | Vegetation | Vehicles. 'Animations' is small clip-packs; animation/animated/动画 in query or category=Animations with a keyword searches is_animated=true across all categories (keyword-less Animations stays exact).

image_url.description: Optional reference image for visual search (http(s) CDN URL; local: file_upload first). Described into search terms (mode=image, separate rate limit/quota). Takes precedence over 'query'.

offset.description: Zero-based match index (default 0, capped at 200; refine query instead of paging deeper).

query.description: 2-3 core nouns, e.g. 'sci-fi mech', 'low poly tree', 'medieval house'. Optional when 'image_url' is set.

sort.description: 'relevance' (default) or 'recent' (newest ingested first; pair with broad keyword + category to browse new additions).

functionDeclarations.name: search_my_assets
functionDeclarations.description:
Semantically search the authenticated user's own completed generation history (across sessions/workspaces/interfaces; never other users, even for admins; excludes deleted/output-less records, library purchases, standalone uploads and local files). Shared catalogs use search_model_lib. Free and synchronous (no polling; downloads/imports nothing). Explicit new-generation requests still use generation tools directly.

Activation: call ONLY when the user explicitly asks to search/find/reuse their own previously generated assets (e.g. "search my generated assets" / "搜我以前生成的素材"). Generic asset search, scene/game building, new generation, or "use existing assets" without explicit personal-history scope do NOT trigger it; clarify ambiguous scope first.

Single asset: pass query (and optional asset_types, top_k). Coordinated set: decompose into roles in ONE call (query = shared scene/style; each role = unique name, query, optional distinct-record count, default 1 — not scene instances: 4 copies of one chair use count=1). Example: {"query":"cozy wooden reading corner","asset_types":["3d"],"roles":[{"name":"seating","query":"wooden reading chair"},{"name":"table","query":"wooden side table"}],"top_k":5}. Scans all eligible records (top_k limits returned candidates only).

asset_types.description: Generation task categories to scan. Omit for all four; does not change ownership.

query.description: Asset to find, or shared scene/style requirements for a set.

roles.description: Optional roles supplied by the calling agent; up to 12. Omit for a single search. This tool does not invent roles.

count.description: Distinct generation records required for this role, default 1; not file count or scene instance count.

name.description: Unique role label within this request.

query.description: What this role must match, evaluated together with the shared query.

session_id.description: Optional caller context metadata, not a search filter.

top_k.description: Maximum returned candidates per role, default 5; raised to count when needed. Includes selected records. Does not limit scanning.

workspace_name.description: Optional caller context metadata, not a search filter; search covers all of the user's workspaces.

functionDeclarations.name: search_tts_voices
functionDeclarations.description: Find available speech voices by name or sound description; returns canonical IDs, formats, each voice's supported `emotions` and whether it accepts a free-form `emotionPrompt`. Free, no synthesis. Omit query to browse; use offset for pagination; pass emotion to keep only voices that accept it. catalog reports all public voices and provider/model availability; total counts matching available voices. Private clones: provider=fal. Use real IDs; never substitute named characters. Choose a match unless an exact named voice is unavailable or ambiguous. Style requests may go directly to generate_tts.voice_query.

emotion.description: Optional filter: keep only voices that support this emotion. Check a returned voice's `emotions` field (empty means the voice cannot change emotion).

language.description: Optional language, e.g. Chinese, English, Japanese; common codes zh/en/ja accepted.

provider.description: Optional filter: minimax/volc/qwen browse public voices; volc_voicelib is the Volc purchased voice library (e.g. 天津相声男声); fal lists only your own completed voice_clone results. Usually omit; choose by voice.

query.description: Voice name or sound description, e.g. 熊二 2.0 or mature warm English narrator. This is NOT the text to speak.

functionDeclarations.name: seedance_portrait_library
functionDeclarations.description: Manage the signed-in user's saved virtual portraits, shared with Lab3D. Reuse one approved character for consistent appearance across clips, including talking-head video (数字人、口播). Find saved portraits with list. For an existing asset:// reference, use get with id set to that reference. Use add only to register new source media by URL. Pass an Active reference as-is in generate_video's matching media URL field. Use one library per video.

id.description: Asset ID or the full reference for get or remove. Remove only when requested.

library.description: Omit for the default library. Qianfan generation uses a random video seed with the selected registered asset. RavenZone availability depends on Team access and rollout.

media_type.description: Required for operation=add: Image, Video, or Audio.

model.description: Default and Qianfan libraries require doubao-seedance-2-0-260128 (2.0 standard) or doubao-seedance-2-5-260628 (2.5). RavenZone supports all models listed here when available.

name.description: Character name for add: 1–64 characters in the default/qianfan library; 1–39 for RavenZone subjects.

page.description: 1-based page for list or uploads, 20 items per page.

page_only.description: For uploads, use true to browse indexed pages with hasMore. Omit for an exact totalCount.

url.description: For add, pass an HTTP(S) media URL from uploads, a completed file_upload or your own completed generation task. Use virtual or authorized likenesses.

functionDeclarations.name: set_canvas_cover
functionDeclarations.description: 替换画布封面：提供已上传的 image_url，或 node_id 与可选 image_index 从图片节点选择产物。只更新封面，不覆盖节点和连线。

functionDeclarations.name: tripo_decimate
functionDeclarations.description: Reduce polygon count / retopologize a 3D model using TripoAI (defaults to retopology v3.0). Pass EITHER 'original_model_task_id' (Tripo-only generate_3d_model task — non-Tripo IDs from hunyuan/Tencent/Rodin are rejected) OR 'url' (download/export non-Tripo or local models and upload via file_upload).

face_limit.description: Target faces: v3.0/v2.0 500–20000 tris or 500–10000 quads (optional, auto); v1.0 required.

model.description: Retopology version: v3.0 (default; smart_uv/quad), v2.0 (smart retopo), v1.0 (basic decimation; requires face_limit).

original_model_task_id.description: Prior Tripo generate_3d_model task ID (not hunyuan/Rodin). Required unless 'url' is set.

quad.description: Output quad mesh (default false; costs more than triangles on v3.0).

smart_uv.description: v3.0 only (rejected on v1.0/v2.0): unwrap UVs during retopology (free, no UV preview image; use dedicated UV task for preview).

url.description: Public model CDN URL (e.g. from file_upload; required for non-Tripo/local models or without original_model_task_id).

functionDeclarations.name: tripo_mesh_segmentation
functionDeclarations.description: Segment a 3D model into semantic parts using TripoAI. Pass EITHER 'original_model_task_id' (Tripo-only generate_3d_model task — non-Tripo IDs from hunyuan/Tencent/Rodin are rejected) OR 'url' (download/export non-Tripo or local models and upload via file_upload).

model_version.description: Default v2.0-20260430 (semantic). Generation versions like P1/H3.1 are rejected.

original_model_task_id.description: Prior Tripo generate_3d_model task ID (not hunyuan/Rodin). Required unless 'url' is set.

split_by_connectivity.description: Also split parts by mesh connectivity (optional).

url.description: Public model CDN URL (e.g. from file_upload; required for non-Tripo/local models or without original_model_task_id).

functionDeclarations.name: tripo_texture_model
functionDeclarations.description: Re-texture a 3D model using TripoAI (pass original_model_task_id or url; optional text/image/style prompts). Target the exact mesh being retextured; before transferring maps to an existing rig, verify UV layout and material slots. Local files: file_upload first.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

delight.description: Texture 3.5 only: remove baked lighting from reference image (default true).

model_version.description: Default v3.5-20260815; do not pass geometry versions (P1/P2/H3.1).

original_model_task_id.description: Prior generate_3d_model task ID (required unless 'url' is set).

texture_quality.description: Default standard; fast (3.5 only, same price/size, less detail); extreme is 8K.

url.description: Direct model CDN URL (required unless 'original_model_task_id' is set).

functionDeclarations.name: unimate_motion_generate
functionDeclarations.description: Generate character motion for an already-rigged humanoid or Rodin quadruped FBX (does not rig) and return an animated FBX. Humanoids: Mixamo FBX recommended (MIA/Rodin human qualify; Unity/Unreal/Tripo also work). Quadrupeds: Rodin quadruped FBX, describe four-legged movement and verify gait. Write short training-style captions starting with "An object" for ONE action (e.g. "An object walks forward."). Multi-action sequences (e.g. left punch then right punch): call once per action and chain clips in-engine; one 60-frame clip cannot reliably hold two ordered actions. Retry with different phrasing if motion is ignored. Fixed per-call credit price, billed only on success. Local files: file_upload first.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

model_url.description: URL of the rigged FBX (Mixamo humanoid recommended, or Rodin quadruped).

prompt.description: Motion description, e.g. "An object walks forward." Required unless rewritten_text is given.

rewritten_text.description: Optional training-style English caption overriding prompt (use when prompt is non-caption style or complex non-English). At least one of prompt/rewritten_text required.

functionDeclarations.name: unirig_rig
functionDeclarations.description: Auto-rig a 3D model. Omit engine to use Rodin; honor any explicit engine choice. Rodin supports humanoids, quadrupeds, dragons, kaiju, custom skeletons, USD-family inputs, stock clips (via list_rodin_rigging_animations) or matching FBX clips; re-attaches original textures on FBX/GLB round trips, reuses confirmed textures with asset_id, or generates new textures with image_url + explicit material. For a standard humanoid needing a Mixamo 22-bone T-pose FBX for UniMate, set engine=mia. Set engine=unirig for a lower-cost generic skeleton, unusual anatomy, long robes/capes, or rigid mech joints (reuse compatible rigs; bind each rigid armor section to one joint). Set engine=tripo for Tripo Auto-Rig v3.0 (VRM naming; hexapod/octopod/serpentine/aquatic topologies; clear T/A-pose for bipeds, standing pose for quadrupeds). Inspect a preview or ask if anatomy is unclear. Credits per successful task are 225 for Rodin, 225 for Tripo, 60 for MIA, and 30 for UniRig. Rodin out_format defaults to the input format for GLB/FBX and FBX otherwise. Matching formats helps preserve embedded textures; conversion can lose PBR channels. Local files: file_upload first.

animation_presets.description: Rodin only: case-sensitive IDs from list_rodin_rigging_animations (e.g. human_000090). Mutually exclusive with animation_urls.

animation_urls.description: Rodin only: compatible single-take FBX clip URLs (<=25 MiB each). Mutually exclusive with animation_presets.

asset_id.description: Rodin only. Completed official Hyper3D Rodin task ID or UUID. Mutually exclusive with model_url.

bone_template.description: Rodin only: default human (Mixamo with fingers). auto picks a preset; custom requires exactly one of skeleton_description or hierarchy_json.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned cost quote.

hierarchy_json.description: Rodin custom only: JSON array of 1–256 nodes (name, int parent with -1 root, optional transform, positive length). Mutually exclusive with skeleton_description.

image_url.description: Rodin only: optional JPG/PNG/WebP reference for skeleton selection; required with non-None material on uploaded models.

in_place.description: Rodin only (with animation_presets): true exports looping locomotion clips without root displacement.

material.description: Rodin only: default None for model_url; reuses confirmed textures for asset_id.

model_url.description: Input model URL. All engines: GLB/FBX/OBJ. Tripo/Rodin: +STL. Rodin: +.usd/.usda/.usdz/.usdc. Rodin may pass asset_id instead.

rig_type.description: tripo only: skeleton topology (default biped; others requires v3.0).

skeleton_description.description: Rodin custom only: describe body plan and special bone chains. Mutually exclusive with hierarchy_json.

skinning_method.description: Rodin only: default core for humanoids, shell otherwise.

spec.description: tripo biped only: bone naming standard (default unity).

functionDeclarations.name: update_canvas_graph
functionDeclarations.description: 整包更新已有画布图，用于修复或批量改写节点：mode=replace 覆盖、merge 按节点 id 增量合并，remove_node_ids 删除节点，指向已删节点的连线会自动剪掉。写入前做与 create_canvas 相同的结构校验。画布正在编辑或运行任务时拒绝覆盖，请关闭画布后调用。dry_run=true 只校验不写入。

graph.description: 画布图定义：节点 type 用语义名（image/text/…），会自动映射为前端 React Flow 类型

# 对话总结

## 项目概览

**Unity 2022.3.62f3c1 + URP 2D**，工程路径 `D:\unity\project\three_cup_2026_11`。

**核心玩法**：一张水彩画被中央墙分成左右两半，各有一个颜料精灵。每个角色带一个"视窗"——透过它看到的是**视窗自身覆盖位置**的地形，而非自己脚下。因此玩家必须不断切换主控，靠队友的视窗辨认路径，走到污渍处按 F 清除。两处污渍都清完才通关。

## 主要成果

### 架构

| 组成 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `LevelConfig` (SO) | 单关配置：id、显示名、关卡预制、视窗尺寸/偏移 |
| `LevelCatalog` (SO) | 关卡顺序总表 |
| `LevelSession` | 场景常驻，负责实例化、放人、接终点、计命、进下一关 |
| 关卡预制体 | 地形 + 污渍 + 出生点标记，5 关（L001~L005） |

### 脚本结构（`Assets/Scripts/GrayBox/`）

```
Core/       PlayerSide, DeathCause, GrayBoxSorting
Input/      InputRouter（单人点击选中 / 双人分键）
Player/     PlayerMotor2D, PlayerVisual, PlayerSpriteAnimator
Vision/     VisionWindow, VisionFog
Level/      LevelConfig, LevelCatalog, LevelSession, LevelGoal,
            Checkpoint, WinChecker, StainDissolve
Mechanism/  Hazard, Switch, ToggleBlock, ISwitchTarget
UI/         PrototypeHud, DeathPopup, FailPopup, PopupFont, SpriteFrameEffect
```

### 自定义 Shader

- **`GrayBox/VisionFog`** — 两矩形视窗挖洞 + 羽化（`_Feather` 世界单位）、视窗描边（可用 `ShowWindowEdge` 开关）、通关时 4 点扩散溶解
- **`GrayBox/StainDissolve`** — 污渍清除的 3 点错开扩散溶解

### 已实现的系统

- **3 条命**：掉坑与机关致死走同一 `Kill(DeathCause)` 路径，各扣 1 命
- **0.5 秒无敌帧**：防止持续判定机关一帧扣光命数
- **手动存档点**：复活回最近经过的存档点（按 order 递增，走回头路不回退），无存档点则回出生点
- **死亡弹窗**：锁操作 2 秒 + 显示"角色A/B 已死亡"
- **失败弹窗**：命数耗尽后显示，按 R 重开本关
- **通关流程**：两处污渍清完 → 遮蔽层 1.8 秒溶解 → 等 2 秒 → 进下一关（换关自动 `ResetFog`）
- **自动进关**：最后一关提示"已是最后一关"

### 美术接入

| 素材 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 角色序列帧（8×3 @160px） | 按亮度去背生成 `*_alpha.png`，PPU 按根节点 0.8 折算（A=76, B=57），轴心 X 取内容中心、Y 使脚底在轴心下方 0.4 |
| Tile（1200² 画布） | 裁到内容（留白 12px），PPU = 边长/0.8，平台用 `Tiled`+`Continuous` 平铺 |
| 污渍（8 张） | 裁到内容、PPU 600，挂 `Visual` 子物体，`localY = -0.9 + 高度/2` 贴台面 |
| 背景 | 左右各 960×1080（PPU 120），排序 −10 |
| 遮蔽层 | 空白画布（PPU 960），`_Tile=(3, 14/9)` 平铺，**明确不压暗** |

## 关键设计决策

| 决策 | 结论 |
|---|---|
| 探索记忆 | **不做**，每次都要靠视窗重新摸 |
| 切换主控 | **完全免费**（点击到角色才切换，点空地无效） |
| 视窗映射 | 逐关可选平移/镜像（枚举已留，未实际用） |
| 引导层 | 常亮，排序 25 |
| 污渍可见性 | **显示在遮蔽层之上**，难点从"搜索"变成"路径不可见" |
| 周期激光 | **已删除**（用户决定），L004 只剩尖刺 |
| 世界观 | 水彩画 / 颜料精灵 / 污渍 / 裱纸 / 透光口（代码名不变） |

## 五个关卡的现状

| 关卡 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| L001 | 基础直路 + 1 个坑 |
| L002 | 平行阶梯（两人高度接近才能互相看见） |
| L003 | 长距离横移 |
| L004 | 尖刺 + 2 个存档点（另 4 关无存档点） |
| L005 | 跨屏开关 + 显隐桥，宽坑物理上跳不过去 |

## 踩过的坑（已验证并修复）

1. `WinChecker` 的 `heldSeconds < requiredSeconds` 在 `requiredSeconds=0` 时恒为假 → 一加载就通关
2. 对已切好的贴图重复赋值 `spritesheet` + `SaveAndReimport()` **无效** → 需直接改 `.meta` 的 pivot 再强制重导入
3. 预制资产上 `Collider2D.bounds` 是零尺寸 → 校验要用 `size × lossyScale` 自算
4. 关卡里早期创建的机关/终点是**内联对象而非预制体实例** → 改预制体对它们完全无效（踩了两次）
5. 相邻碰撞体精确平齐会导致"接缝卡人" → 需重叠 0.15，但桥梁另一端必须贴边否则变隐形墙
6. 死亡后安全点被记录在机关内部 → 死亡循环

## 当前状态 / 待决

**代码可运行，5 关全部通关验证通过，`Tools/GrayBox/Validate Levels` 全过。**

**用户最后一次提问聚焦在"关卡地图和机关种类的设计"**，我的回复给出：

- **机关优先级**：视窗锚定器 → 光柱 → 塌陷平台 → 移动平台
- **L006~L009 具体布局概念**：光柱、视窗锚定、塌陷平台、错峰协作
- **三条节奏规范**：每关一个新机制、2~3 个决策点、致死段后 1.5 单位内放存档点
- **两条路线待选**：A 先扩机制（从视窗锚定器开始）／ B 先用现有机制做 L006~L009

**尚未开始**：音频、教学关（`TutorialCatalog` 为空）、跳跃手感（coyote time / 跳跃缓冲）、关卡结算窗口、光柱与视窗锚定器实现。

- [2026-11-22 20:54:46] 地形碰撞体接缝规范（2026-11-22 修 L005 卡人得出）：**相邻两块可行走碰撞体不能精确平齐对齐**，共面静态 BoxCollider 的公共边会让角色横向移动被顶住（典型"接缝卡人"），必须让它们重叠约 0.15；但同一块"桥"的另一端要**正好贴住**出发平台的边缘——如果往那边也重叠，桥 1.2 高的侧面会变成走道上撞到的隐形墙，比原问题更烦人。加宽/改桥梁尺寸后要两端分别确认。
- [2026-11-22 22:21:27] 角色序列帧与翻转（2026-11-22）：素材是 `Assets/Pictures/characters/A/B_序列帧_1280x480.png`（无 alpha，已按亮度 205→225 去背生成 `*_alpha.png`，原图保留）。布局 8 列×3 行、每格 160×160：行0 站立6帧、行1 行走8帧、行2 跳跃5帧（蓄力/上升/最高/下落/落地）。**角色根节点 localScale=0.8，所以 PPU 要按 0.8 折算：A 用 76、B 用 57**，世界高度约 0.81/0.80。轴心 X 取角色内容中心（A 66px、B 61.5px，否则 flipX 会横向跳 0.29 单位），Y 使脚底位于轴心下方 0.4 世界单位。动画由 `PlayerSpriteAnimator` **代码驱动而非 Animator**：跳跃帧按 grounded + 垂直速度选帧，才能和起跳/落地时机严格对齐。高亮圈已按新角色尺寸改为 0.85×0.80。
- [2026-11-22 23:26:01] 世界观定调（2026-11-22 用户确定）：一幅未完成的水彩画上洇开了污渍，两个颜料精灵在画布上奔走，**目标是到达指定位置消除污渍**。机制代码名不变，只换说法：地形平台=干透的颜料带、中央墙=画布中缝、遮蔽层=未揭开的裱纸、视窗=透光口、**终点(LevelGoal)=污渍（待清洁点）**、存档点=留白、尖刺=硬结的颜料碴、显隐方块=补上的笔触、开关=颜料罐、命数=颜料存量、死亡=被擦掉。**周期激光（烘干光栅）已按用户要求删除**，Laser.prefab 与 TimedToggler.cs 均已移除，关卡 4 只剩尖刺一种致死机关。

- [2026-11-23 19:57:28] 通关表现与视窗裁剪（2026-11-22）：①两处污渍清完 → 遮蔽层用**同一套扩散逻辑**整层溶解（`VisionFog.DissolveRoutine`，0.8 秒、4 个起点铺向四角）→ 再等 2 秒（`LevelSession.advanceDelay`）→ 进下一关；换关时必须 `visionFog.ResetFog()`，否则下一关遮蔽层仍是消失状态。②污渍清除特效是自制 shader `GrayBox/StainDissolve`（3 个种子点错开扩散、半径按"到最远角"计算保证擦干净），原 `Effect_CleanBurst` 帧动画已删；死亡水痕仍用 `SpriteFrameEffect` 帧动画。③视窗按 `VisionFog.splitX`（默认 0，即中央墙位置）裁到各自半侧，**靠近中央墙时视窗可见宽度会变窄**（4.0→3.5→2.5）。④**坑**：`WinChecker` 里 `heldSeconds < requiredSeconds` 在 `requiredSeconds=0` 时恒为假，会导致关卡一加载就通关；判定必须先显式要求 `bothCleaned` 再计时。

用户要求：机关和对应的简单关卡一起做，但先给出机关符合世界观的描述，以及便于制作贴图的提示词。

所以这一步是设计文档输出，不是写代码。用户想要：

2. 便于制作贴图的提示词（AI 生图提示词，用于生成机关贴图）

之前对话已验证的机关优先级：
- 视窗锚定器 → 光柱 → 塌陷平台 → 移动平台

而且用户之前选了方向。当前状态说"尚未开始：音频、教学关、跳跃手感、关卡结算窗口、光柱与视窗锚定器实现"。

让我先看看项目实际情况，确认现有机关有哪些，避免重复。我应该读一下 Mechanism 目录。

messages.content:
我已经确认了现有机关与关卡结构（`Switch`/`ToggleBlock`/`Hazard`/`Checkpoint` + L001~L005 平台预制）。下面是 4 个新机关的世界观包装、玩法参数、实现要点和贴图提示词，每个配一个最小验证关。

---

# 一、机关总览

| # | 世界观名 | 机制 | 层级/排序 | 验证关 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **漏光缝** | 纸背漏光，把被裱纸盖住的一段路照亮（纯视觉） | 洞写在 Fog shader 里；光晕 sprite 排序 11 | L006 |
| 2 | **压纸钉**（图钉） | 把当前视窗钉在原地，人可走开 | 排序 25（看得见才敢踩） | L007 |
| 3 | **未干的颜料块** | 站 ~0.6 秒塌陷，2.5 秒后重新凝住 | 排序 5（视为地形，被裱纸盖住） | L008 |
| 4 | **游动的颜料团** | 缓慢往返的移动平台 | 排序 5（被裱纸盖住） | L009 |

排序号继续从 `GrayBoxSorting` 取，不硬编码。

---

# 二、逐个机关

## 1. 漏光缝

**世界观**：裱纸没有完全贴合，某一处翘起了一道细缝，画室的光从纸背漏进来，正好照亮一小片干透的颜料带。颜料精灵站在光里就能看清纸下的路——但这道光不属于任何人，它只会待在一个固定的地方。

**玩法**：一条竖直光带（默认宽 2.6、高贯穿画面），光带内的裱纸"透光"，下方地形因此可见。**地形本来就在，碰撞一直有效**，所以它是纯信息机关：不难在跳，难在"你必须先站到光里才敢跳"。

**实现要点**：`VisionFog` 现在只挖左右两个矩形洞，需要扩成 `_HoleCount + float4 _Holes[8]`（世界坐标 min/max），由 `LightPillar` 每帧写入。已有的 `_Feather`、`splitX` 裁剪逻辑对额外洞同样生效。光晕另用一张 sprite（`Additive`、排序 11）叠在洞上面做氛围，可关闭。

**贴图**：`漏光缝`（不需要精确比例，我会按内容裁切）

> 提示词（英文）：`Vertical shaft of warm light leaking through a crack in thick watercolor paper, seen from the front, top-down 2D game asset. Soft creamy white-gold glow (#FFF4D6) fading heavily at the edges, a brighter thin filament running down the center as the paper crack, faint watercolor bloom bleeding outward, no hard outline, no object silhouettes, no text. Isolated on pure white background, centered, full height.`

> 中文释义：正面看着从厚水彩纸裂缝里漏下的一道竖光，柔和的奶白偏金，边缘重度羽化，中轴有一条更亮的细线代表裂缝，外侧有水彩渗开的晕，无硬边、无物体轮廓。

---

## 2. 压纸钉

**世界观**：一枚旧图钉插在画纸上。钉头压住的地方，透光口就被钉在了原处，不再跟着颜料精灵漂移。精灵可以走开，那块画布仍然亮着——代价是它自己脚下彻底看不见了。

**玩法**：角色踩上去（Trigger）→ 该角色视窗位置锁定为锚点；离开锚点 3 单位或再次踩下 → 解除。锁定期间视窗仍按分半规则被裁，所以钉在太靠中缝的位置会自己缩窄。

**实现要点**：`VisionWindow` 加一个 `SetAnchor(Vector2 worldPos)` / `ClearAnchor()` 的重载路径，内部仍是"角色位置 + 偏移"的求值，只是换成"锚点 + 偏移"。`PinStation` 组件记住最后踩上的角色侧，`LevelSession` 换关/复活时统一 `ClearAnchor`。

**贴图**：`压纸钉`，世界 0.6 × 0.6，与污渍同级 PPU 600

> 提示词（英文）：`A single old brass pushpin stuck into watercolor paper, seen slightly from above, 2D game prop asset. Rounded dome head with wear and a little rust at the rim, short shaft disappearing into the paper, a soft shallow watercolor shadow stain spreading under the head, hand-painted texture, irregular rim, no text, no background elements. Isolated on pure white background, centered, object fills 75% of the frame.`

> 中文释义：一枚旧黄铜图钉略俯视插在水彩纸上。圆顶钉头带磨痕与边缘锈迹，钉身没入纸面，钉头下方有一圈浅浅的水彩阴影晕开，手绘质感，边缘不规则。

---

## 3. 未干的颜料块

**世界观**：这一笔刚上色，还没干透。颜料精灵踩上去，它就塌成一片水痕；过一会儿才慢慢重新凝住。

**玩法**：站上 0.6 秒 → 塌陷（碰撞体失效 + 视觉下垂溶解）；2.5 秒后恢复，恢复时有 0.3 秒宽限，站上去不会立刻再塌。

**实现要点**：`CrumblePlatform` 自己管计时（`OnTriggerStay2D` 累计、`Collider2D.enabled` 切换），视觉直接用现成的 `StainDissolve` 逻辑反向播（我打算把那份 3 点扩散抽成可复用的 `RadialDissolve` 组件，塌陷/凝住共用一个 shader）。

**贴图**：`未干颜料块`，世界 0.8 × 0.4（一块 tile 宽）

> 提示词（英文）：`A single wet blob of ochre watercolor paint on paper, freshly applied and still glossy, 2D platformer ground tile asset. Saturated burnt-ochre body with a wet specular sheen along the top edge, irregular organic outline, a few drips sagging down at the bottom edge, soft pigment bloom into the paper fibers around the rim, no outline stroke, no text. Isolated on pure white background, centered, shape fills the frame width.`

> 中文释义：一块刚刷上、还没干的赭石水彩，表面有湿亮反光，轮廓不规则、底边有几处下垂的流淌，边缘颜料渗进纸纤维，无描边。

---

## 4. 游动的颜料团

**世界观**：一坨浓得化不开的颜料浮在纸上，缓慢地来回游动。站上去，它连你一起带走。

**玩法**：两点间往返，默认周期 5 秒；角色站在上面随之移动。路径如被裱纸盖住，仍然看不见——必须靠队友视窗或压纸钉。

**实现要点**：`MovingPlatform` 在 `FixedUpdate` 里推进 `transform`，并给站在上面的 `PlayerMotor2D` 叠加平台位移（不能直接 `parent`，否则会破坏水平输入与翻转）。到达端点减速停顿 0.2 秒，手感更稳。

**贴图**：`游动颜料团`，世界 1.2 × 1.2

> 提示词（英文）：`A heavy rounded droplet of deep indigo watercolor paint floating on paper, seen from the front, 2D moving-platform asset. Dense saturated blue-violet core fading to lighter edges, a glossy wet highlight on the upper left, two or three small satellite splashes beside it, a very faint soft shadow beneath, hand-painted, organic uneven silhouette, no text. Isolated on pure white background, centered, object fills 70% of the frame.`

> 中文释义：一坨浓稠的深靛蓝水彩悬在纸上，核心饱和、边缘变淡，左上有一点湿亮高光，旁边两三个小飞溅，下方极淡的软影，手绘、轮廓自然不规整。

---

# 三、四个验证关（只做跑通机制，不做美术）

布局是左右各 8 单位、高 9 单位，坐标原点在屏幕中心（和现有 5 关一致）。

```
L006 漏光缝        L007 压纸钉
┌─────┬─────┐     ┌─────┬─────┐
│  ▓  │     │     │  █  │     │
│     │     │     │  ②  │     │     ② = 图钉
│ ██  │ ██  │     │ ███ │     │
│     │ ╎   │     │  ╎  │     │     ╎ = 光带
│     │ ╎██ │     │  ╎  │     │
│ ██  │ ╎   │     │ ███ │     │
│  ●  │  ●  │     │  ●  │  ●  │
└─────┴─────┘     └─────┴─────┘
  右半屏长路断 6 单位，光带下方    右半屏 12 单位长桥 + 3 处 1.2
  露出两段 0.8 宽台阶            窄缺口，视窗默认偏移照不到桥身
```

- **L006**：右半屏表面是一条 12 单位长路，中间 6 单位是**空的**，光带只照出两段 0.8 宽台阶（间隔 1.2）。碰撞全程存在，玩家看不见就会踩空 → 验证"光柱是否真的让人敢走"。
- **L007**：右半屏长桥整体落在默认视窗（偏移 ±8 朝对面）之外，桥面上 3 处 1.2 宽的缺口。角色必须先踩图钉，把视窗钉在桥中段，才能看见脚下 → 验证锚定是否解除"看不见自己脚下"这个核心痛点。
- **L008**：右半屏 8 单位宽坑，坑上 3 块湿颜料（0.8×0.4，间距 1.6）。踩第一块时第二块还凝着，踩第二块时第一块已塌——制造"不能回头"的压力。
- **L009**：左半屏 10 单位宽坑，一块 1.2×1.2 颜料团在 x=±4 往返。验证平台跟随与跳上跳下的判定。

四关都只有 1 个机关、1 处污渍、无存档点（承接前三关"不放存档点"的既定规则）。

---

# 四、贴图通用约束（每张都适用）

1. **纯白背景**出图，我在导入时按内容裁切并算 PPU——和 `污渍` 那套流程一致，所以提示词里不要出现背景场景。
2. **无描边、无黑阴影**：水彩风格靠晕染和明度差，加描边会和现有 tile 冲突。
3. **不规则边缘是加分项**，不要"切圆角"。
4. 配色请从现有四色里挑：`ochre 赭石`、`sage 鼠尾草绿`、`blue 蓝`、`verm 朱红`（`Assets/Tiles/sq_0X_*`），避免引入新色系。
5. 命名建议：`Assets/Pictures/机制/01_漏光缝.png`、`02_压纸钉.png`、`03_未干颜料块.png`、`04_游动颜料团.png`，原图保留，另出 `*_alpha.png`。

---

# 五、需要你定的事

1. **做几个**：4 个全做，还是先做前 2 个（漏光缝 + 压纸钉，这两个最能验证"看不清自己脚下"的核心张力）？
2. **贴图时机**：我建议先用现有 tile 颜色做占位块，把 4 个机关和 4 关代码全部跑通、验证手感，你的贴图到位后我只做替换，不动逻辑。这样你不用等美术。

确认后我就开始实现，并按"一个机关 + 它那一关跑通验证 → 停下等你验收"的节奏推进。

设计机关。已有：Switch(颜料罐) + ToggleBlock(补上的笔触)、Hazard/Spike(颜料碴)、Checkpoint(留白)、Goal(污渍)。

待做的新机关（之前定的优先级）：
1. 视窗锚定器（Window Anchor）——把视窗钉在原地，人可以走开
2. 光柱（Light Pillar）——额外照出一块地形（需要 shader 从 2 矩形扩到 N 矩形）
3. 塌陷平台（Crumble Platform）——踩上去延迟后消失，几秒后恢复
4. 移动平台（Moving Platform）——沿路径移动

这 4 个正好可以各配一关 L006~L009。

世界观映射：
1. 视窗锚定器 → 「镇纸」/「图钉」？水彩画世界观里，把一小块画布的"透光口"钉住。名字：**钉住的透光口 / 图钉钮**。贴图：一枚黄铜图钉/圆头钉压住画面，边缘有水彩晕。
   更贴合：**镇纸**（paper weight）是一个压纸的石块/玻璃镇纸。但这里是钉住视窗 —— 用图钉（pushpin）更贴。或者「未干的胶点」？
   我建议：**图钉桩（Pin Post）** —— 插在画纸上的一枚图钉，旁边飘一圈光晕，表示透光口被钉在此处。
   
2. 光柱 → 「漏光缝」/「光斑」。裱纸（遮蔽层）上有裂缝，光透进来照出一块地形。名字：**透光缝 / 漏光孔**。贴图：一道竖直的柔和光带 + 纸背的裂纹。
   实际上更自然：**笔洗灯**？不。用「漏光」最贴世界观（光从裱纸后面透过来）。美术：不规则椭圆光斑，边缘羽化，水彩晕色。
   
3. 塌陷平台 → 「未干透的颜料带」踩一下会塌。名字：**湿颜料块 / 未干的笔触**。贴图：一块颜色饱和、边缘有淌下痕迹的颜料块，踩上去会有裂纹与下垂。
   
4. 移动平台 → 「漂移的颜料滴 / 顺水漂的颜料」？或者「撕下来的一角纸片」。我觉得 **游动的颜料团** 很好：一坨会自己缓慢摆动的颜料，可以站上去。贴图：圆润颜料团 + 浅影。

另外还需要「开关」和「显隐方块」的贴图（已有概念但可能没有专门美术）。用户可能已用 ToggleBlock.prefab 里的纯色方块。可以顺带给提示词。

再补一个：**视窗锚定器**还可以有反向机制：把视窗钉到对面（跨屏观察），实现"停住队友的视窗"。

现在设计 4 个关卡（L006~L009），每个一个新机关 + 简单布局：

L006 光柱（漏光缝）
- 一条长平台中间有个大坑，左右两侧。光柱在坑上方，照出坑中的踏板 → 但只有走到光柱下才能看见。
- 简单版：右半屏一条长平路中间断开 6 单位；光柱把中间那段"隐形桥"照出来（ToggleBlock 一直 active 但被遮蔽层盖住，光柱照出 → 其实遮蔽层只挡视觉，碰撞是存在的）。所以光柱本质是"揭示看不见但能走的平台"，不需要真正开关。这个太好了：光柱 = 让被遮蔽层盖住的平台可见 → 纯粹视觉机关，实现只需 shader 支持额外矩形。
- 但要小心：光柱照出的地形本来就存在，只是被裱纸盖住。所以玩家必须靠光柱判断落点。
  
L007 视窗锚定器（图钉）
- 左侧角色要把视窗钉在坑上方，然后自己往下掉/往前走，靠钉住的视窗持续看着那块区域。
- 简单版：左侧一条向右的路，中途有个必须跳的窄桥；桥的位置在视窗偏移之外（默认偏移 8），所以需要图钉把视窗留在桥那段。
- 或者：跨屏协作——A 把视窗钉在 B 前方，B 就能看到自己的路（原本 B 的视窗是看向 A 的）。

L008 塌陷平台（湿颜料）
- 一串 3 块湿颜料横跨宽坑，踩上去 0.6 秒后塌，2.5 秒后恢复。两人要错峰通过。
- 简单版：宽坑上 3 块，间距 1.5，只能单人依次踩。

L009 移动平台（游动颜料）
- 一块缓慢左右/上下移动的颜料团，把角色送到对岸；且它的路径被视窗覆盖 → 需要队友看着。
- 简单版：宽坑 8 单位，一块平台在两端往返，周期 4 秒。

嗯，但用户说"机关和对应的简单关卡一起做吧"，也许他想要更少的量。我可以给 4 个机关 + 4 关，但也可以先做 2 个。我应该在输出里给出方案并询问。

不过按记忆"按阶段推进，完成并验证后停下"，我应该先只输出设计文档，等确认。

贴图提示词要考虑风格：水彩、纸质感、不规则边缘、透明背景（PNG）、俯视/正面 2D、与现有 tile 协调（ochre 赭石、sage 鼠尾草绿、blue 蓝、verm 朱红）。PPU 参考：tile 1200 画布内容约 430-480px → 0.8 单位。污渍用 PPU 600。

给每个机关标注建议尺寸（世界单位）和出图尺寸。

机关尺寸建议：
- 图钉桩：0.6×0.6 世界 → PPU 600 时 360px；建议输出 1024² 便于裁切
- 光斑：宽 3~4 单位、高 6 单位（竖长光带）→ 建议 1024×2048
- 湿颜料块：0.8×0.4（一块 tile 宽）→ 1024²
- 移动颜料团：1.2×1.2 → 1024²

提示词要点：
- 水彩画材质、纸纹、半透明晕染、边缘不规则
- 纯色/白色背景（便于去背）或明确透明背景

我还应该说明每个机关的实现要点（脚本/组件），这样用户知道我要做什么。但不要写代码。

我需要注意：不要过长但要完整。用户需要可直接用的提示词。

关于"光柱"实现：shader 从 2 矩形扩到 N 个。当前 VisionFog 支持左右各一个矩形。扩到 N 需要改为数组 _Rect0.._Rect3 或 _HoleCount + 数组。可以用 MaterialPropertyBlock 或直接 setVectorArray（shader 不支持数组 uniform for float4 in all cases — 实际 Unity 支持 float4 _Holes[8]）。可行。

不过等等 — 光柱的语义：额外照出一块地形。如果它照出的区域在对方半屏，那就要裁剪。可以做成"额外视窗"，也遵循 splitX 裁剪。

我要不要提"替代方案"：光柱也可以用 SpriteMask/Overlay 不写 shader。但遮蔽层是自绘 shader，最省的是扩 shader。

好，另外"视窗锚定器"的玩法细节：把视窗钉住 → 角色走开后视窗不动。解除：再按一次 / 走远自动解除 / Switch 型（踩上去钉住，离开解除）。设计成 **Trigger + 踩上去生效，按住"F"钉住，再按 F 解除**？F 已被污渍清除占用，但污渍只在污渍上方。可以复用 F，冲突风险小。或者干脆"踩上去即钉住，离开 3 单位后自动解除"。

我建议：踩上即钉住（一次性），离开超过 3 单位或再踩一次解除。简单可控。

实现：VisionWindow 改为读取一个"anchored position override"。

现在还有排序号：GrayBoxSorting 里已有 Terrain0/Mechanism5/Fog10/Divider15/Player20/Hint25。光柱应该是"在遮蔽层之上"画光斑（因为要照亮被盖住的地形），所以排序 11（Fog 之上）；但光斑如果画在 Fog 上，会盖住地形？其实光柱应该是 shader 里挖洞（增加一个矩形洞），这样地形自然露出来，不需要额外 sprite。而视觉上的"光晕"可以另加一个排序 11 的加法混合 sprite。我建议：功能性 = shader 洞；可选的柔和光晕 = 单独 sprite 排序 11、Additive。

湿颜料块的贴图排序 = Mechanism 5，在 Fog 之下 → 被遮住看不见！这不对。等等，地形是排序 0，在 Fog(10) 之下被遮住 —— 这正是玩法核心（透过视窗看）。所以湿颜料块若在地形层，也应该被遮住 → 玩家靠视窗看它。对的，湿颜料块属于"地形"，应该被遮蔽层盖住。而污渍（Goal）是例外，放在 25 之上。

移动平台同理在地形层被遮住。

图钉桩呢？它是玩家可踩的机关/触发点，应该在能看见的地方 → 排序 25（同引导层）。或者 5 但被遮住。我建议图钉在遮蔽层之上（25），因为玩家需要看到"这里有个图钉可以踩"。

好，这些细节可以写进文档。

关于几个"简单关卡"：用户可能还想新增关卡到 LevelCatalog。需要 LevelConfig asset + prefab + catalog 条目。

我先输出设计文档。长度控制：这确实需要相当篇幅，但要有条理。使用表格 + 代码块画草图。

写提示词时给"中文描述 + 英文 prompt"，因为多数生图模型英文更稳，但也支持中文。我给英文主 prompt + 中文释义，简洁点。

让我组织内容。

机关 1：漏光缝（Light Seam / 光柱）
世界观：裱纸（遮蔽层）没有完全贴合，某一处翘起了细缝，画室的光从纸背漏进来，把一小片干颜料带照了出来。颜料精灵站在这道光里，就能看清纸下的路。
玩法：一条竖直光带，宽度 ~2.5 世界单位，高度贯穿；把遮蔽层在光带内"挖开"（羽化 0.15），因此光带下方的地形可见但不可交互（本来就存在，只是平时被遮住）。
实现：VisionFog shader 增加最多 4 个"额外洞"矩形（世界坐标 uniform 数组），由 LightPillar 组件每帧写入；光斑 sprite 可选（Additive、排序 11）。
贴图：不需要功能贴图；只需要一种"漏光"的柔光带，竖长，白色偏暖（#FFF3D6），边缘重度羽化，中间有一条更亮的细线表示纸背裂纹。

机关 2：压纸钉 / 图钉（Pin / Anchored Window）
世界观：一枚插在画纸上的旧图钉，钉头压住的地方，透光口就被"钉"在那里，不再跟着颜料精灵移动。精灵可以走开，那一块仍然亮着。
玩法：角色踩上去（Trigger）→ 该角色当前视窗位置被锁定为锚点；角色离开 3 单位或再次踩下 → 解除。锁定期间视窗仍按分半裁剪。
实现：VisionWindow 增加 anchored override；Pin 组件单侧绑定。
贴图：一枚俯视的黄铜/铁质圆头图钉，钉头略偏侧，落点在纸上有水彩晕开的浅影；钉头边缘不规则，有锈迹。0.6×0.6 世界。

机关 3：未干的颜料块（Wet Pigment / 塌陷平台）
世界观：这一笔刚上色、还没干透。踩上去会塌成一片水痕，几秒后慢慢重新凝住。
玩法：站立 0.6 秒后塌陷（碰撞体失效 + 视觉下垂溶解），2.5 秒后恢复；恢复期间若角色站在上面则不会立刻塌（给 0.3 秒宽限）。
实现：CrumblePlatform + 复用 StainDissolve 风格的 shader（或用 alpha 收缩 + 位移）。
贴图：一块饱和的颜料块（赭石/朱红），边缘有流淌下垂的痕迹，表面有湿亮反光；塌陷帧可以只做 3 帧或纯 shader。

机关 4：游动的颜料团（Drifting Pigment / 移动平台）
世界观：一坨浮在纸上的浓颜料，缓慢地来回游动，站上去会被一起带走。
玩法：沿两点间往返，周期可配；角色站在上面随平台移动（用 platform 父级或速度叠加）。
实现：MovingPlatform，FixedUpdate 用 MovePosition 或 transform；PlayerMotor2D 需要父物体跟随或 add velocity。
贴图：圆润的一团深蓝/靛颜料，边缘有少量飞溅的小点，底部有一层极淡的影子。

关卡：
L006 漏光缝 —— 右半屏长路中间 6 单位断口，断口上方有一道漏光缝，光下露出两段窄台阶（宽 0.8，间隔 1.2）。左半屏是安全平地，左角色必须站到高台边缘才能把视窗覆盖到断口。
L007 压纸钉 —— 左侧一条向右的长桥（12 单位）中途 3 处窄缺口；桥整体在默认视窗覆盖范围之外（因为视窗偏移为 +8 朝对面）。左角色必须先踩图钉把视窗钉在桥中段，再向前跳。
L008 未干颜料块 —— 右半屏 8 单位宽坑，坑上 3 块湿颜料（0.8×0.4），间距 1.6。踩第二块时第一块已恢复，因此可以来回；但连续踩会全塌，需要等。
L009 游动颜料团 —— 左半屏 10 单位宽坑，一块 1.2×1.2 的平台在 x=±4 往返，周期 5 秒；视窗必须钉住（复用 L007 的图钉）才能看清落点 → 组合关。

嗯，L009 组合两个机制可能超"简单"。可以让 L009 只做移动平台。

排版：光柱 hole 排序、图钉 25、湿颜料与移动平台 5（被遮蔽）。

好，写出来。还应该提供"贴图通用风格约束"，避免每张重复。

给 PPU 建议：与污渍一致用 600（小物件）；光晕用 300。

另外注意：用户说"机关和对应的简单关卡"。也许"简单关卡"指"简易的验证关卡"而不是正式关。我理解为：每个新机关配一个最小可玩关卡来验证机制。这样更轻。我可以说明：每个机关配一个"验证用简关"（L006~L009），机制确认后可以合并成正式关。

  Write-Output ("{0}  {1}x{2}" -f (Split-Path $f -Leaf), $w, $h)
}
